title: Strengthening ChatGPT’s responses in sensitive conversations
summary: OpenAI collaborated with 170+ mental health experts to improve ChatGPT’s ability to recognize distress, respond empathetically, and guide users toward real-world support—reducing unsafe responses by up to 80%. Learn how we’re making ChatGPT safer and more supportive in sensitive moments.
body: OpenAI collaborated with 170+ mental health experts to improve ChatGPT’s ability to recognize distress, respond empathetically, and guide users toward real-world support—reducing unsafe responses by up to 80%. Learn how we’re making ChatGPT safer and more supportive in sensitive moments.
summaryZh: 加强 ChatGPT 在敏感对话中的响应。OpenAI 与 170 多名心理健康专家合作，提高了 ChatGPT 识别痛苦、同理心响应并引导用户获得现实世界支持的能力，将不安全响应减少高达 80%。了解我们如何让 ChatGPT 在敏感时刻变得更安全、更具支持性。
